title: Manyhands JSON v1 setup cancel preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of repo setup-cancel: the pending setup that will be ended. It is read from the registry alone: nothing is connected to. A repository with no setup is a no-op (already_applied).

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: The setup that will be ended.

root.description: The repository's root, as the request's records name it.

kind.description: enable for a first-time setup, change for a change of an enabled repository's setting.

state.description: recorded until the remote is seen to hold the setup's branch, then published. A publish between the preview and the confirm is refused as external_change.

branch.description: The setup's branch, manyhands/setup/<setup_id>, on the remote and in the repository.

remote.description: The name of the setup's remote.
